params.claimDelay_: Timeout in seconds, from one hour through 30 days.
params.feeBps_: Release fee in basis points, at most 1,000.
params.feeToRewardsBps_: Rewards share of the fee, at most 10,000.
params.operator_: Account permitted to release or refund funded escrows.
params.owner_: Account permitted only to replace the operator.
params.rewardsPool_: Rewards fee recipient; required when fees are enabled.
params.treasury_: Treasury fee recipient; required when fees are enabled.
params.usdc_: ERC-20 token address, not the native-value interface.

claimAfterTimeout(bytes32).notice: Anyone may trigger a full refund to the depositor after the deadline.

deposit(bytes32,uint256).notice: Deposit amount in 6-decimal ERC-20 base units; no native value is accepted.
